title: Semi-structured interviews with linguists about Open Science
purpose: General example corpus for Plan #8 (docs/plans/008_finish_workbench.md); an example, not the product's purpose.

source.creator: Elen Le Foll
source.consent_statement: The interviewees consented to the interviews being recorded and to the anonymised transcription being published on an open repository (00_README.md, 'Data collection').

human_coding.coder: Elen Le Foll (the corpus author), exported from OpenQDA

pin_label.label: Qualitative Coding's October 2026 theory (run e131eb55), not its newest run (a67d7d6a)
pin_label.reason: Qualitative Coding's status page says of this run, which it calls "the published example", that it "rejects 46% of proposed quotes" (docs/CURRENT_STATE_AND_ROADMAP.md:32), against its "wrong if" line: "the misfit count stays above roughly a quarter of applications" (:22-23). "The earlier e131eb55 predates the disprove test" (:34). Its newest run, a67d7d6a (2026-11-05), rejects 11.7% (:34), and QC says "a lower rejection rate alone does not pass" (:24-25). QC uses "published" for both runs (:32 and :34); this page calls a67d7d6a its newest run. QC has committed neither that theory nor its revision, so this page reads the newest Open Science theory it has committed with its cited passages: run e131eb55, from 2026-10-09. Qualitative Coding has been asked to commit its current theory as a file (issue #205 in its repository).
pin_label.repin_when: When Qualitative Coding commits the newer theory in its own repository, this pin moves to it and every figure built on the theory is recomputed (Plan #8, open question Q26).
pin_label.source: docs/planning/open-questions.json Q26; qualitative_coding docs/CURRENT_STATE_AND_ROADMAP.md:22-25, :32, :34 and :41-47; BrianMills2718/qc issue #205

producer_human_comparison.statement: QC has recorded no comparison with the author's coding for this run.
producer_human_comparison.newer_run_note: For its newer run a67d7d6a, QC records 605 of 758 located author passages "touched" (79.8%) and 454 mostly covered; a plain one-prompt pass on the same model touched 587 (77.4%). QC calls "touched" generous, and there is one human coder, so it is "a comparison, not a reliability ceiling".
